01 — About

The story so far

I'm a Master's student in Information Science at UW–Madison, currently interning as a Technical Product Manager at Marketeq Digital.

At NPCI, India's national payments infrastructure, I defined technical requirements and simulated 25,000+ concurrent transactions to validate platform scalability. At ArisGlobal, working with J&J, AstraZeneca, and Boehringer Ingelheim, I identified a reporting gap and independently built a BI solution that delivered $150K in annual savings, earning a Spot Award.

What drives me isn't the code. It's the moment a well-defined requirement becomes a shipped feature that measurably moves a business outcome. I'm building at the intersection of AI and product, from agentic RAG pipelines that audit financial documents to LLM-powered tools that automate requirements documentation.

Currently seeking Fall 2026 Co-ops and Full-Time 2027 roles in TPM, Business Analysis, AI Product Management, and Technology Consulting.
